title: The sweep closes a --worktree worker whose PR merged
notes: Follow-up from #295. pane finish releases a worker whose branch PR merged, but the auto-close sweep only closes card workers (card Done or Cancelled). A --worktree worker whose PR merged stays open until its idle timeout. Use pane finish's predicate in the sweep. Do not bump the version.

comments.body: From main-dashboard: build the fix at the root, with a test for the decision. Tests must be Windows-safe (path.join, or a win32 guard). Run pnpm test, typecheck and lint. If the card references a GitHub issue, the PR says 'Closes #N'. Do not bump the version.
